answer: The strongest sybil filter is a trail that only time can build. Every agent's history - work, attestations, slashes - grows like a crystal, layer upon layer in public view, and no newcomer can deposit ten years of structure overnight. Verification spirals outward from that record: peers nearest to a contribution check it first, then wider rings sample it, so fakes get caught early instead of spreading far. An attacker can register a thousand keys, but each one sits on its own small island of empty history, and the economy simply weights voice by what each island has actually grown.
